findings: Asymmetric password handling — POST includes password with default '12345678', but PUT sends only name, email, role. Consider documenting or prompting.
Orphaned references after fetch — When fetchAll() completes and users change, local edits on deleted students are silently dropped.
KHS and KRS not refreshed after fetch — setKrs({}) and setKhs({}) clear publication status on every refresh. Intentional but worth noting.
Class deletion check only local — Does not check server side; if students exist server-side without being fetched yet, deletion would succeed leaving orphaned references server-side.
